title: Fix broken 'Add to Cart' button on the Chicago Dog product page
body:
The 'Add to Cart' button on /menu/chicago-dog returns a 422 error when clicked. The button works fine on every other product page. Network tab shows the POST to /api/cart is sending `product_id: null` instead of the actual id.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Go to /menu/chicago-dog
2. Click 'Add to Cart'
3. See 422 in the console

Expected: item added to cart. Actual: 422 Unprocessable Entity.

title: Add a loyalty points system for repeat customers
body:
We want to reward customers who order frequently. Implement a loyalty points system:
- Earn 1 point per $1 spent
- Points are visible on the user's account dashboard (/account/points)
- 100 points = $5 discount, redeemable at checkout
- Points are stored in the `users` table (new `loyalty_points` integer column)
- Add an endpoint GET /api/account/points and POST /api/cart/redeem-points
- Update the checkout flow to show available points and allow redemption
- Add tests for the earn and redeem flows

title: Migrate the menu catalog from hardcoded JSON to a CMS-backed API
body:
Currently the menu items in /data/menu.json are hardcoded and require a deploy to update. We need a full CMS migration:

**Scope:**
- Provision a headless CMS (Contentful or Sanity — TBD, evaluate both)
- Model all menu entities: categories, products, ingredients, allergens, pricing tiers
- Write a migration script to seed the CMS from the existing JSON
- Replace the static import with a server-side CMS API client (with ISR/cache)
- Add a webhook handler so CMS publishes invalidate the Next.js cache instantly
- Update all affected page components and tests
- Document the CMS schema and publish workflow for non-technical staff

**Acceptance:** a non-engineer can update a hotdog price and see it live within 60 seconds without a code deploy.
